start: Android phone, Settings > Rest timer and sounds, 'Workout sounds' on, a workout running

user_sees: The 'Rest-over sound' row now reads 'Workout sounds are off: Rest is over only buzzes'
must_not: The default rest or the chosen rest-over sound changes

steps.action: Tick a set, lock the phone and wait for the rest to end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' notification with 'Next: <set>' and 'Complete set'
The phone buzzes, the watch buzzes
must_not: Any chime, bell, beep or whistle from the phone

steps.action: Turn 'Workout sounds' back on and finish the next rest
user_sees: 'Rest is over' rings with the chosen sound again
must_not: The phone keeps buzzing only after the switch is back on

start: 'Workout sounds' off, MettleUp open on screen during a rest

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end with the app on screen
user_sees: The app shows the rest is over
must_not: A second buzz from a second alert

start: 'Workout sounds' off; in Android settings the member turned off vibration for the 'Rest is over' quiet channel

steps.action: Open Settings > Rest timer and sounds
user_sees: Row 'Rest alerts: Silent — tap to fix'
must_not: No warning while 'Rest is over' can neither ring nor buzz
A caption that only talks about sound when the fix is the buzz

user_sees: Android's settings page of that 'Rest is over' channel

start: A rest is counting down with 'Workout sounds' on

steps.action: Open Settings mid-rest and turn 'Workout sounds' off, then lock the phone
must_not: The running rest still ends with a sound

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
must_not: The old sound plays because the rest started with sounds on

start: 'Workout sounds' off, phone locked on a gym bench

steps.action: Rest ends while the phone lies on the bench
user_sees: 'Rest is over' on the lock screen with the next set's name
must_not: Any sound that draws others' attention after the member chose quiet
More than the next set's name and numbers on the lock screen
